title: Hex-SUB1-IPC 2025-067 - PROOF OF CONCEPT: FEASIBILITY OF PHOTODYNAMIC DIAGNOSIS IN BLADDER CANCER PATIENTS WITH SUB-ONE-HOUR INSTILLATION TIME OF HEXAMINOLEVULINATE (HEXVIX®)
official: Hex-SUB1-IPC 2025-067 - PROOF OF CONCEPT: FEASIBILITY OF PHOTODYNAMIC DIAGNOSIS IN BLADDER CANCER PATIENTS WITH SUB-ONE-HOUR INSTILLATION TIME OF HEXAMINOLEVULINATE (HEXVIX®)
summary: Main objective: The main objective is to evaluate the quality of tumor fluorescence by Hexvix® when the blue light cystoscopy is started 30 min after the timepoint of instillation of Hexvix® into the bladder.
conditions: primary or recurrent confirmed papillary bladder cancer (BC)

interventions.name: HEXVIX 85 mg, poudre et solvant pour solution intravésicale

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1.	man/woman above 18 years
2. 2.	primary or recurrent papillary bladder cancer confirmed by cystoscopy or imaging, scheduled for TURB with Hexvix®
3. 3.	Covered by a Healthcare System;
4. 4.	Signed informed consent obtained prior to initiation of any study-specific procedures and treatment as confirmation of the patient’s awareness and willingness to comply with the study requirements.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1.	Cystoscopy or bladder biopsies performed without previously identified tumor lesions
2. 10.	Previous diagnosis of porphyria
3. 11.	Bladder inflammation related to chronic urinary tract infection or mechanical irritation of the bladder mucosa due to indwelling catheter or recent intravesical treatment (BCG or chemotherapy)
4. 12.	Vessie peu compliante / capacité vésicale insuffisante ne permettant pas de retenir le Hexvix
5. 13.	Adults under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship, or judicial protection);
6. 14.	Inability to comply with the medical follow-up of the trial for geographical, social, or psychological reasons.
7. 2.	Flat lesion without papillary tumor associated
8. 3.	Maximal TURB for muscle-invasive bladder tumor (prior to radio-chemoradiotherapy)
9. 4.	Other TURB procedures not requiring prior Hexvix® instillation
10. 5.	Urethral stricture
11. 6.	Previous pelvic radiotherapy
12. 7.	Any severe uncontrolled medical condition considered by the investigator as a contraindication for using tested product
13. 8.	Pregnant women or those who may become pregnant (without effective contraception) or breastfeeding
14. 9.	Hypersensitivity to the active substance hexaminolevulinate hydrochloride or to any of the excipients listed in section 6.1. of the SmPC

sites.f: Institut Paoli Calmettes – département d'oncologie médicale
